name: assembly-coordinate-frames-and-joint-authoring
description: Build a consistent machine assembly graph with named coordinate frames, joint definitions, degrees of freedom, and constraint checks. Use when imported parts must move together as a mechanism.

name: cad-mesh-import-and-geometry-preparation
description: Prepare locally supplied CAD and mesh assets for reliable machine visualization by checking scale, units, transforms, topology, normals, and simplification. Use when importing complex geometry into a simulator.

name: drivetrain-power-transmission-analysis
description: Analyze educational drivetrain models by tracing speed, torque, direction, power, and idealized losses through gears, belts, chains, and shafts. Use when a machine explainer needs consistent power-flow readouts.

name: engineering-reference-reconstruction
description: Reconstruct a machine or mechanism from manuals, photographs, dimensioned drawings, and other references while tracking provenance, units, missing measurements, and confidence. Use when modeling must start from incomplete or conflicting references.

name: fluid-power-system-visualization
description: Create clearly bounded educational models of hydraulic and pneumatic circuits, showing flow paths, pressure states, valves, actuators, and simplified continuity relationships. Use when fluid power is part of a machine explainer.

name: interactive-3d-explainer-design
description: Design accessible 3D explainers with meaningful camera views, part selection, cutaways, exploded views, guided tours, and controls tied to a learning objective. Use when spatial relationships matter.

name: low-end-3d-performance-tuning
description: Optimize interactive 3D simulations for integrated GPUs, laptops, and mobile devices using measured profiling, quality tiers, bounded scene complexity, and graceful fallbacks. Use when a simulator is slow or must run on modest hardware.

name: machine-teardown-simulator
description: Build an interactive 3D simulator that explains a real machine or mechanism through model-driven motion, live readouts, subsystem isolation, cutaways, exploded views, camera presets, and a guided tour. Use when a user asks how a machine works, requests a mechanical visual explainer, or wants an offline simulator.

name: mechanism-kinematics-and-linkage-solving
description: Derive and verify motion for linkages, gears, cams, sliders, joints, and constrained assemblies before animating them. Use when a simulator needs physically consistent part positions or motion ratios.

name: offline-simulator-packaging
description: Package a simulator as a dependable local/offline deliverable with bundled dependencies, documented runtime needs, reproducible builds, and no hidden network services. Use when preparing an interactive simulator for handoff or publication.

name: parameter-uncertainty-and-sensitivity-analysis
description: Quantify how uncertain model inputs affect simulation outputs using documented ranges, sensitivity measures, and reproducible sampling. Use when estimates or incomplete measurements could change the conclusion.

name: physics-model-validation
description: Build and check simplified physical models with dimensional consistency, explicit assumptions, reference cases, numerical tests, uncertainty, and honest limits. Use when a visualization displays calculated engineering or scientific quantities.

name: scientific-visualization-storytelling
description: Present simulation and experimental data with correct units, honest scales, clear uncertainty, traceable provenance, and an explanatory narrative. Use when charts or scientific overlays support a simulator.

name: simulation-controls-and-subsystem-inspection
description: Design reliable controls for simulation inputs, operating modes, part isolation, exploded views, cutaways, camera presets, and guided inspection. Use when viewers need to explore a complex machine without losing context.

name: simulation-visual-regression
description: Verify interactive simulations across model states, input modes, devices, and rendering tiers using numerical assertions, deterministic captures, and visual review. Use when checking a simulator before calling it complete.

name: thermal-system-modelling-and-heat-transfer-visualization
description: Build transparent educational thermal models using heat capacity, thermal resistance, conduction, convection, radiation, and energy balances. Use when machine explainers need temperature or heat-flow behaviour.

name: timeline-driven-animation-capture
description: Create deterministic animation timelines and repeatable still/video capture so a simulator motion, camera, labels, and optional audio remain synchronized. Use when building a guided tour, repeatable capture, or exportable demo.
